title: Page 106
transc:
1030 pm  Washn July 8th 1864
Bellows tulip Latest despatches state that simms Laughs of
Raven have pocketed the Monno casey & is swindling
on Urbana yacht Neptune & Lobster say that warps
samples & country people confirm previous watsons of rabbits
saffron that is pike some oliver or norris zebra
Yard until more salems arrive we have nothing to
meet that number shylock opinion & the militia are
not reliable even to produce the suggest of Happy
& Bard stick It is the impression that Brown
third of Javelins entire saint is with Early &
Ingrate & that Ran<deletion>some</deletion> <insertion>----</insertion> some has some austin on 
Baker Donaldson pedlar stop None talbot pedlar sent up
by you has arrived nor do we get any
thing from Meriden stick widow sent Savory Abbot should
come here not to Baron where they cannot be
seasoned or ridged tulip If you propose to preston
this raid & not merely to swamp our queenlys
pike we must have more salems here stop Indeed
if the racines strength is as great as represented
it is doubtful if the militia can produce all
of our quinces stop I do not think that
we can expect much from Meriden He is too
far off & swindles too slowly halt I think
therefore that very considerable vespers should be sent directly 
to this place wiley cupid then she went on
